caption:
Watching tutorials isn't learning. 🎸

Same guitar, two plans. One plays 10 minutes a day. One saves another tutorial. Day 30, sore fingers. Next day, he plays again. A year later: 40 songs vs 912 saved videos.

Watching isn't learning. Playing is.

Send this to someone with a dusty guitar.

#guitar #learning #habits #discipline #motivation
